Lighting and composition: Soft side light revealing fabric texture; 50mm full-body with the pallu and both feet inside frame. Compose for 4:5.

Styling must follow the scene without altering reference identity. Adapt hair only when styling requires it; retain the actual hairline and recognizable face. records.seo_title: A Small Burst of Motion — Profile Picture Prompt | PicMagic
records.seo_description: Express personality through one legible graphic gesture while keeping the face familiar. Copy the reference-first prompt into your chosen image tool; results vary.

faqs.question: Can I use my own photograph?
faqs.answer: Yes. Copy the complete prompt into your chosen image tool and attach your photograph. Your reference controls identity; the fictional preview supplies styling. Results can vary.

faqs.question: Will this work as a circular profile picture?
faqs.answer: Use the square composition and keep your full face inside the central circle. Check the finished result at small size before using it.

records.image_brief:
Create a PicMagic fictional preview, not a personalized customer result. One fictional Indian woman about 48, medium-deep complexion, salt-and-pepper bob with natural waves, small oval glasses and an ordinary full build; simple rust-coloured top.

Use no real private person or competitor image as a reference. Create a photographic chest-up avatar of one person in a relaxed slight turn, looking toward camera. Two broad hand-drawn brush arcs follow the outer shoulder line: one muted coral arc on one side and one deep teal arc on the other. They sit behind the shoulders like an illustrator’s notation of a lively turn, not extra arms, wings, a glowing halo or repeated silhouettes. Keep the head, facial landmarks and hair free of marks. Use a clean warm-grey ground, soft natural face light and one genuine small smile. The brushwork is visible pigment with imperfect edges; avoid confetti, symbols and many thin doodles.

OUTPUT: One 1:1 square master, target 1024 × 1024. A single close or chest-up portrait with the face as the primary focal point. Centre the eyes, nose and mouth; keep the complete head, hair and chin comfortably inside the central circular crop, with visible breathing room above and below. Aim for the head to occupy roughly 55–65% of canvas height; adapt to the person's actual hair and headwear without trimming them. The identity and one broad treatment must remain legible as both square and circular avatars at 40, 64 and 128 pixels. Put decoration toward the sides and behind the shoulders, not across facial landmarks. Do not add a printed circular border, multiple panels, duplicate heads, tiny writing, logos or watermarks.

Natural age cues and proportions; no airbrushed skin, ethnicity substitution, stereotyped features, anatomical distortion or watermark. This image is an AI-generated example.
records.why_ai: Combines a reference-conditioned photograph with carefully registered illustration adapted to a small avatar.
